title: BUG: Fixed a crash when reading VASP output files
description:
Certain versions of VASP will write POTCAR hashes to the CONTCAR in place of element symbols, e.g. "Na_pv/6a2f546d" where ASE expects "Na". This caused ase.io.vasp.read_vasp_configuration to crash when it tried to treat the POTCAR hash as an element. This has been fixed with a few additional lines, and no existing code has been altered.

diff:
diff --git a/ase/io/vasp.py b/ase/io/vasp.py
index 71b9db15e..0ae513c79 100644
--- a/ase/io/vasp.py
+++ b/ase/io/vasp.py
@@ -243,6 +243,14 @@ def read_vasp_configuration(fd):
             except KeyError:
                 atomtypes = atomtypes_outpot(fd.name, numsyms)
 
+    # Certain versions of VASP will write POTCAR symbols with hashes
+    # to the CONTCAR. These take the form "Na_pv/6a2f546d", so split
+    # on "/" and "_" and take the left hand side each time.
+    for i, atomtype in enumerate(atomtypes):
+        potcar_label = atomtype.split('/')[0]
+        element_symbol = potcar_label.split('_')[0]
+        atomtypes[i] = element_symbol
+
     for i, num in enumerate(numofatoms):
         numofatoms[i] = int(num)
         atom_symbols.extend(numofatoms[i] * [atomtypes[i]])
